**New Features / Improvements:**
* Added initial controls to reduce logging verbosity. By default, it now only logs mapped requests.
* Added proxy toggle state control to allow regular traffic flow without mapping requests.
* Updated release workflow to use project file versions and release notes location by default.
* Improved code structure for maintenance and extending features.

**Bug Fixes:**
* Fixed false errors when mapping to an IP where there isn't a service listening for requests.

**Known Issues / Limitations:**
* Cached pages may still appear work as unmapped. Use a private browser window to work around that.
